summary.text: Rita Sanders is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 45, and was elected in 2020 and re-elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Rita Sanders's occupation as a commercial real estate developer.

paragraphs.text: Rita Sanders was born Rita Gomez on June 30, 1958, in Honolulu, Hawaii.
Rita Sanders graduated from Livermore High School in 1976 and completed a dental assisting program at Bryman College in San Jose, California, in 1977.
Rita Sanders worked as a district representative for Congressman Jeff Fortenberry and served as mayor of Bellevue.
Rita Sanders has belonged to the Kiwanis Club of Bellevue since 2015 and the UNMC Board of Counselors since 2016.
Rita Sanders married Rick René Sanders on April 24, 1998, and they have two children.
